findings.title: No Organization or WebSite structured data was found anywhere on the site
findings.evidence: 0 of 17 crawled HTML pages contain JSON-LD or microdata of an Organization/LocalBusiness/WebSite type. Types observed across the site: none

suggested_action.summary: Publish one Organization (or LocalBusiness) JSON-LD block site-wide, plus a WebSite block on the homepage.
steps: Add an Organization node with name, url, logo and a description.
Add sameAs links to the official profiles the organization controls.
Include contact details (telephone / email / address) matching the visible contact page.
Serve the block in the initial HTML on every page, or at least on the homepage and about page.

findings.impact: There is no explicit machine-readable statement of who the site belongs to, so the brand's identity, official name and linked profiles must be inferred from prose - a common cause of entity ambiguity and misattribution.

findings.title: Substantial page content is absent from the initial HTML and appears only after JavaScript execution
findings.evidence: On https://www.nike.com/help/a/military-discount the initial HTML contains 737 words of visible text while the rendered DOM contains 1301 (43% of the visible text is added by JavaScript). https://www.nike.com/help/a/military-discount: raw 737w -> rendered 1301w (43% added); https://www.nike.com/help/a/nfl-jersey: raw 737w -> rendered 1161w (36% added)

suggested_action.summary: Serve the primary content of these pages in the initial HTML response (server-side rendering, static generation or hydration of pre-rendered markup).
steps: Identify which content blocks are injected client-side on the listed pages.
Render that content server-side (SSR/SSG) or inline it as pre-rendered markup that hydration replaces.
Re-test with JavaScript disabled and confirm the key facts appear in the raw HTML.
Where full SSR is impractical, mirror the key facts in JSON-LD delivered in the initial HTML.

findings.impact: Retrieval clients that do not execute JavaScript see only a fraction of the page, so product, pricing or company facts that live in the rendered DOM may not be extracted at all.

findings.title: The homepage redirects to a different domain
findings.evidence: https://www.nike.com/ answered with HTTP 301 and a Location of https://www.nike.in/. The origin server responded normally; this audit does not follow redirects across registrable domains, so the destination was not crawled. Redirect chain observed: https://www.nike.com/ -> https://www.nike.com/in/ -> https://www.nike.in/. This is the normal shape of a country, locale or brand consolidation redirect and is not by itself a defect.

suggested_action.summary: Re-run the audit directly against https://www.nike.in/ to audit the content.
steps: Run the audit again with https://www.nike.in/ as the target to assess the actual content.
If the destination is a locale variant, audit the locale a given audience is served.
Confirm the redirect is a 301 when the move is permanent, so the destination accumulates the authority.

findings.confidence_reason: deterministic rule on measured values; direct DOM/HTTP observation; single-page sample; consistent across 1/1 pages
findings.impact: Nothing here indicates the site is unavailable. It does mean the audited hostname is not where the content lives, so this run carries no evidence about the destination.
findings.priority_reason: impact 0.25 (severity low) x reach 1.00 x confidence 0.82 x fixability 0.90

technical_details.observation: https://www.nike.com/ answered with HTTP 301 and a Location of https://www.nike.in/. The origin server responded normally; this audit does not follow redirects across registrable domains, so the destination was not crawled.
technical_details.details: Redirect chain observed: https://www.nike.com/ -> https://www.nike.com/in/ -> https://www.nike.in/. This is the normal shape of a country, locale or brand consolidation redirect and is not by itself a defect.

possible_benign_explanations: Country, locale and brand-consolidation redirects are normal and intentional; this finding records what happened, it does not assert a defect.
The audit's own same-site policy, not the site, is the reason the destination was not crawled.

The origin server responded normally; this audit does not follow redirects across registrable domains, so the destination was not crawled.' deviates from AI indexing and extraction standards.

reasoning.remediation_phase: Phase 3: Authority Corroboration & Context Enrichment (21-45 Days)
